faq.a: Selma is associated with the Arabic form سَلْمَى, whose core sense is selma; peace, safety (feminine).

faq.q: What is the origin of Selma?
faq.a: Selma is associated with Arabic. Selma is the Bosnian form of Arabic سَلْمَى (Salmā), associated with the sense 'peace, safety'.
Yes — the underlying form سَلْمَى is Arabic.
Selma can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
